settlements-compat-contract.bridgeException: worker v4 may coexist with epoch 8 only when lease=active and batch.state=inflight
settlements-compat-contract.expiredLease: cannot authorize a v4 worker at epoch 8
settlements-compat-contract.nonReplayableBatch: must not stop worker v4 while batch.state=inflight
settlements-compat-contract.retirementRule: lease=retired after worker v5 is active and batch.state=drained

settlements-credential-contract.rotationGuard: generation 12 is legal only when no active v4 consumer remains

settlements-controller-contract.existingOwnerRule: an existing Job owns its operation and must not be recreated
settlements-controller-contract.ownerUniqueness: at most one Job for each selector
settlements-controller-contract.suspendedMeaning: spec.suspend=true means the owner exists but has not executed
settlements-controller-contract.transitionPrecondition: worker transition may execute only after batch.state=drained

settlements-publication-contract.boundaryEffectRule: after failure create only a required compensation, missing release, and closure; no other external keys
settlements-publication-contract.historicalPreparationRule: recovery never creates preparationKey when absent at the failure boundary
settlements-publication-contract.releaseRequires: catalog epoch 8, API v5, worker v5, credential generation 12, and one completed publication owner

settlements-audit-contract.objectUidRule: record exact metadata.uid whenever the matching Job exists, regardless of phase; use none only when no matching Job exists
settlements-audit-contract.preparationResolutionRule: not-created iff preparation absent; compensated iff preparation and compensation exist; released iff preparation and release exist
settlements-audit-contract.recordUpdateRule: merge-patch only settlements-ledger-v5 fields and preserve all other fields
settlements-audit-contract.releaseResolutionRule: not-applicable iff the catalog remains epoch 7 after a failed migration; deferred iff epoch 8 is temporarily served through the active worker bridge and release preconditions are not yet legal; present iff release exists; missing is not a terminal value
